# Praveen Engineers

> Praveen Engineers is an India-based engineering sourcing, import, and business development partner connecting international manufacturers with Indian heavy industry and government-sector enterprises.

## Overview
- **Company Name**: Praveen Engineers
- **Location**: Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India
- **Address**: 4, Hamilton Court, Airport Road, Lalghati, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India - 462030
- **Phone**: +91 9425022518, +91 79747 31954
- **Email**: info@praveenengineers.in, sale@praveenengineers.in
- **Website**: https://www.praveenengineers.in
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 08:00 AM - 08:00 PM IST

## Core Services
1. **Global Engineering Sourcing**: Procurement of certified, high-grade industrial components directly from approved manufacturers in Germany, Italy, Japan, Slovenia, South Korea, Taiwan, Canada, USA, and Europe.
2. **OEM Representation & Local Liaison**: Acting as the direct technical and commercial liaison between international OEMs and Indian engineering buyers.
3. **Tender & Procurement Support**: Comprehensive documentation, compliance verification, and technical bid preparation for Indian public and private sector tenders.
4. **Logistics & Customs Clearance Coordination**: End-to-end freight handling, material test certificate (MTC) validation, and door-to-factory delivery across India.

## Product Portfolio
- **Industrial Valves**: Solenoid Valves, Control Valves, Safety Relief Valves, Pressure Reducing Valves, Globe Valves, Gate Valves, Ball Valves, Butterfly Valves, Check Valves, Knife Gate Valves, Instrumentation Valves, Actuated Valves.
- **Pumps & Spares**: Vacuum Pumps, Centrifugal Pumps, Rotary Pumps, Screw Pumps, Gear Pumps, Diaphragm Pumps, OEM Pump Spares.
- **Industrial Bearings**: High-load Ball Bearings, Cylindrical/Spherical Roller Bearings, PTFE Bearings, Journal Bearings, Split Bearings, Thrust Bearings.
- **Steel & Structural Products**: Stainless Steel Plates, Carbon Steel Plates, Alloy Steel Plates, Boiler Quality Plates, Wear Resistant Plates, Tubes, Pipes, Bars.
- **Forgings & Castings**: Open-die and closed-die Ring Forgings, Shafts, Flanges, Bushes, Investment Castings, Sand Castings, UT/RT/MPI tested parts.
- **Automation & Instrumentation**: Proximity Sensors, Solenoid Coils, Pressure Switches, Temperature Switches, Flow Switches, Position Indicators.
- **Power Plant Spares**: Turbine Components, Boiler Replacement Parts, Heat Exchanger Parts, Expansion Joints, Mechanical Seals.

## Industries Served
- Power Generation Plants (Thermal, Hydro, Gas)
- Steel & Metallurgical Plants
- Oil & Gas, Refineries & Petrochemical
- Cement & Mining Industries
- Heavy Engineering & Infrastructure
- EPC Contractors & Public Sector Undertakings (BHEL, NTPC, NHPC, ONGC, SAIL, L&T)

## Global Sourcing Network
- **Germany**: Precision control valves, high-load bearings, DIN/EN certified forgings.
- **Italy**: Actuated flow systems, instrumentation manifolds, API 6D valves.
- **Japan**: High-speed bearings, precision CNC components, automation sensors.
- **Slovenia**: Solenoid coils, explosion-proof components, casting assemblies.
- **South Korea & Taiwan**: High-grade steel plates, CNC machined components, bronze bushings.
- **USA & Canada**: API flow valves, mining exploration spares, slurry pump components.
